column1: # Words around a number that decide its reading: liang_counter (2 reads 两 before
# it), code_cue/phone_cue (digits one by one; phone 1 is 幺), room_after, year_after
# (a four-digit year), year_not, ratio_cue (H:MM is a score), duration_cue (H:MM:SS
# is a duration), range_unit (a range mark after it is 到).
# 2室1厅 两室一厅, 2梯4户 两梯四户: rooms of a layout and lifts (2026-11-02, TN round 34; was
# 二室). A room number of three or more digits (1502室) is read by room_after first.
# Owner evaluation sets (2026-10-14): more code labels, a service number before
# the word a call takes, and the Alipay hotline.
# 登录12306网站 一二三零六: a site named by its number reads digit by digit (2026-11-02, TN round 31;
# was 一万二千三百零六)
# 2站 两站 (owner sets, 2026-10-14); 排 and 班 also name a row or class (2排15座, 2班)
# Owner evaluation sets, phase 6 (2026-10-14): 203诊室 二零三诊室
